book.name: Matiyu
book.title: Matiyu Matiyu beleŋ mere igiŋ Yesu niŋ yitiŋ kayyiŋ

content: Yesu mayniŋ yeŋ mere sege iramiŋ
Be, Yesu gob sabamiŋ kuruŋ goyen pasi irdeb tigiri teŋ komatmiŋ yago gaha yinyiŋ:
“Pasoba dula nalu kuruŋ gobe molye go yeŋ nurde haŋ gogo. Go nalurebe ne Al Urmiŋ gayen kuruse hende mununeŋ mununeŋ niŋ asogo haniŋde nernayiŋ,”
yiriŋ.
Be, goyenterbe pris buda gote karkuwaŋmiŋya Yuda marte doyaŋ mar parguwak yagoya beleŋ pris buda gote kuruŋmiŋ Kaiafasyen yare gabu iramiŋ.
Irdeb daha mat kura Yesu go usi irde teŋ mayteke kamyeŋ yeŋ mere sege iramiŋ.
Goyenbe yiŋgeŋ mere maydeb, “Dula nalu kuruŋ gayenter ma gwaha titek. Moŋgo goke igiŋ ma nurde al beleŋ fuleŋa dirnayiŋ geb,” yamiŋ.
Bere kura beleŋ det fimiŋ hamiŋeŋ igiŋ wor po goyen Yesu tonaŋde wok iryiŋ
Be, Yesu go komatmiŋ yagoya Betani taunde Saimonyen yare hinhan. Saimonbe bikkeŋ busuka manaŋ hinhin.
Be, Yesu go keperde hikeyab bere kura gore det fimiŋ hamiŋeŋ igiŋ wor po alabasta hora beleŋ po irtiŋ yaliŋ kusamuŋ goyen bana hitiŋ go tawaŋ tonaŋde wok iryiŋ.
Det fimiŋ damum hende wor po goyen bere gore Yesu tonaŋde wok irke keneŋbe komatmiŋ yago beleŋbe biŋ ar hende daniŋ buluŋ ira yeŋ gusuŋaŋ hamiŋ.
“Go tukuŋ al yunke manhan hora kuruŋde po damu tike hora go teŋ al buniŋeŋ faraŋ yurwoŋ,” inamiŋ.
Be, Yesu go mere teŋ hinhan goyen nurdeb, “Deŋbe daniŋ bere go tagal uneŋ buluŋ irhaŋ? Yeŋbe mata igiŋ wor po nira.
Al buniŋeŋbe deŋya hugiŋeŋ hinayiŋ. Goyenbe nebe deŋya hugiŋeŋ ma hitek.
Bere gare det fimiŋ ulner wok ira gabe ne kammeke mete nirnayiŋ goke gitik nira.
Niŋgeb fudinde wor po dineŋ hime. Kame al beleŋ ne niŋ naŋa kuruŋ ga tagalde tukuŋ heŋyabe bere gare mata tiya gake wor tagalde hinayiŋ, irde matamiŋ goke dufay heŋ hinayiŋ,” yinyiŋ.
Yudas Iskariot beleŋ Yesu asogo haniŋde kiryiŋ
Be, Yesu komatmiŋ 12 bana goyen al deŋem Yudas Iskariot ineŋ haŋyen gore pris buda gote karkuwaŋmiŋ hitte kuriŋ.
Kuŋbe, “Yesu hantiŋde kermekeb muruŋgembe dahade nunnayiŋ?” yinyiŋ. Irkeb silwa hora kapyaŋ heke kuŋ 30 hekeb unamiŋ.
Go kamereb Yudas go Yesu goyen daha mat kura asogom haniŋde kereŋ yeŋ beleŋ niŋ naŋkeneŋ hinhin.
Dula funaŋ
Be, Yesuyen komatmiŋ go haŋka wawuŋbe beret yis miŋmoŋ nen nen nalu heweŋ tiya yeŋbe Yesu gusuŋaŋ iramiŋ. “Damde kuŋbe Pasoba biŋge gitik irde netek yeŋ nurde ha?” inamiŋ.

Irkeb Yesu beleŋ wol heŋbe, “Yerusalem taun bana kuŋbe al kura gor keneŋbe gaha inayiŋ. ‘Tisa beleŋbe, “Nalunebe binde hihi. Niŋgeb neya komatneyabe gere yare Pasoba biŋge netek,” yihi,’ gwaha innayiŋ,” yinyiŋ.
Irkeb komatmiŋ yago goyen Yesu yinyiŋ go po gama irde kuŋbe Pasoba biŋge nen nen gitik tiyamiŋ.
Be, wawuŋbana wor po hekeb Yesuya komatmiŋ 12 goya Pasoba biŋge niniŋ yeŋ keperamiŋ.
Biŋge nene heŋyabe Yesu beleŋbe, “Fudinde wor po dineŋ hime. Deŋ gayen kuratiŋ kura beleŋ asogoner haniŋde niryeŋ,” yinyiŋ.
Irkeb komatmiŋ yago gobe kandukŋeŋ wor po nuramiŋ. Irdeb kura kame yuŋkureŋ yuŋkureŋ, “Doyaŋ Al Kuruŋ, ne niŋ wet yeŋ ha?” yeŋ gusuŋaŋ iramiŋ.
Irkeb wol heŋbe, “Al kura neya tumŋaŋ haniŋ teŋ fe koroŋ bana kera gore asogo haniŋde niryeŋ.

Ne Al Urmiŋ gabe Al Kuruŋyen mere basaŋ mar beleŋ bikkeŋ asaŋde kayamiŋ goyen po gama irde kameŋ. Goyenbe al kura asogoner haniŋde niryeŋ al goke buniŋeŋ wor po nurde uneŋ hime. Al go kawaŋ ma hiriŋ manhan kanduk buluŋ goyen go ma kenwoŋ,” yinyiŋ.
Irkeb Yesu asogomiŋ haniŋde kertek al Yudas beleŋ, “Tisa, ne niŋ daw yeŋ ha?” inyiŋ. Irkeb wol heŋbe, “Gwaha, gobe ge po geb,” inyiŋ.
Yesu beleŋ beretya wainya komatmiŋ yunyiŋ
Be, biŋge nene heŋyabe Yesu beleŋ beret teŋbe Naniŋ turuŋ irdeb ubala teŋbe, “Beret dunhem gahade gayen po nebe deŋ ge teŋ kameŋ. Niŋgeb goke teŋbe beret gabe gasoŋne geb, teŋ nenaŋ,” yinyiŋ.
Irdeb wain fimiŋ gisu bana hitiŋ go teŋbe sopte Al Kuruŋ turuŋ irde, “Deŋ tumŋaŋ ga teŋ nenaŋ.
Al megen haŋ kuruŋ gote mata buluŋ halde yuneŋ yuneŋ niŋ teŋ Al Kuruŋ beleŋ biŋa tiyyiŋ goke teŋ darine wok irde kameŋ. Niŋgeb wain ga teŋ nenaŋ.
Fudinde dineŋ hime. Wain fimiŋ gayen tebaŋ ma neweŋ. Kuŋ kuŋ Nanne beleŋ alya bereyamiŋ doyaŋ yiryeŋya goyenter gab deŋya tumŋaŋ wain fimiŋ gergeŋ sopte netek,” yinyiŋ.
Be, go kamereb Yesuya komatmiŋ yagoya goyen tikiŋ heŋbe Olip doŋdoŋde hurkamiŋ.
Pita helwaŋ hiyyeŋ goke tagalyiŋ
Be, hurkuŋ gor heŋbe Yesu beleŋ gaha yinyiŋ: “Haŋka wawuŋbe ne mununniŋ yeŋ fere nirkeb deŋbe tumŋaŋ nubul teŋ busaharnayiŋ. Mata goke Al Kuruŋyen asaŋde gahade katiŋ hi:

content.text: ‘Sipsip doyaŋ al maymeke sipsipmiŋbe burgagaw kernayiŋ,’ yitiŋ. Sekaraia 13:7

content: Goyenbe kame sopte huwardebe ne wa meheŋ heŋ Galili naŋare kweŋ,” yinyiŋ.
Irkeb Pita beleŋbe, “Al hoyaŋbe tumŋaŋ gubul tinayiŋ. Goyenbe nebe epte ma wor po gubul tiyeŋ,” inyiŋ.
Irkeb Yesu beleŋ wol heŋbe, “Fudinde wor po gineŋ hime. Haŋka wawuŋbe tatirok ma mere tikeyabe ge beleŋ wawuŋ karwore ne niŋ yeŋ, ‘Al gobe go ma nurde uneŋ hime,’ yawayiŋ geb,” inyiŋ.
Goyenpoga Pita beleŋbe, “Nebe al beleŋ mununnayiŋ gega, ge niŋ yeŋ, ‘Yeŋ ma nurd unhem,’ ma wor po yeweŋ,” inyiŋ. Irkeb kadom yago manaŋ tumŋaŋ gwaha ala inamiŋ.
Yesu Getsemani heŋ Al Kuruŋ mere iryiŋ
Be, gor mat kuŋ naŋa deŋe Getsemani gor forok yeŋbe komatmiŋ yago, “Gar keperde doyaŋ nirde hike neb irar ira kuŋ Al Kuruŋ mere ireŋ,” yinyiŋ.
Irdeb Pitaya Sebedi urmiŋ waraŋ Yonya Yemsya yadeb gasuŋ hoyaŋde kwamiŋ. Goyareb Yesube dufaymiŋya biŋyabe kanduk wor po hiriŋ.
Irdeb mel karwo go yinyiŋ. “Kanduk kuruŋ wor po mununke kamtek nurhem geb, neya gar heŋbe Al Kuruŋ mere irdeya ga hinayiŋ!” yinyiŋ.

Gwaha yineŋbe gor mat muŋ kura siŋgir teŋ kuŋbe biŋ tadam mat wulgurut yeŋbe, “Ado, igiŋ kenem kanduk kuruŋ gayen teŋ siŋa irayiŋ. Goyenbe nere dufay ma gama irayiŋ. Gere dufay po gama irayiŋ,” inyiŋ.
Gwaha teŋbe mulgaŋ heŋ kuŋbe komatmiŋ karwo gob firtiŋ yinyiŋ. Irdeb Pita isaŋ heŋbe, “Mel, deŋbe neya muŋ kura hitŋeŋ teŋ Al Kuruŋ mere irde ga ma fernayiŋ?” yinyiŋ.
Irdeb, “Ferde ma Al Kuruŋ mere irde hinayiŋ. Gogab uŋgura waŋ tuŋaŋ durkeb epte ma katnayiŋ. Tontiŋbe Al Kuruŋ mere ird ird niŋ wilakŋeŋ nurde haŋ. Gega ultiŋbe piŋeŋ heŋ haŋ,” yinyiŋ.
Irdeb sopte yubul teŋ kuŋ Al Kuruŋ mere irdeb, “Ado, kanduk ga ne beleŋ ma teweŋbe kanduk gayen pasi irtek beleŋ miŋmoŋ hiyeŋ kenem nebe dufayge po gama irdeb teweŋ,” yiriŋ.
Be, Al Kuruŋ mere irde pasi heŋbe sopte mulgaŋ heŋ kuŋ komatmiŋ karwo gob diliŋ kanduk hekeb firtiŋde hike yinyiŋ.
Yeneŋbe yubul teŋ sopte mulgaŋ heŋ kuŋbe Al Kuruŋ mere iryiŋ gwahade po sopte mere iryiŋ.
Be, mulgaŋ heŋ kuŋbe komatmiŋ yago goyen, “Deŋbe usaŋ heŋ firtiŋde po haŋ? Ga kennaŋ! Ne Al Urmiŋ gayen mata buluŋ mar haniŋde nerd nerd nalu gobe bikkeŋ gago forok yihi.
Huwarke kuniŋ! Asogo haniŋde nertek albe bikkeŋ gago waya geb,” yinyiŋ.
Yesu teŋ fere tiyamiŋ

Be, Yesu gobe gwaha yeŋ hikeyabe komatmiŋ kura Yudas gobe al yade wayamiŋ. Al buda gobe fuleŋare niŋ bidilaya nukwaya yade wayamiŋ. Mel gobe pris buda gote karkuwaŋmiŋya Yuda marte doyaŋ mar parguwakya beleŋ yad yerke wayamiŋ.
Yesu go asogom haniŋde kertek al goreb tetek mar go gaha yinyiŋ: “Kuŋ forok yeŋbe mata kura tiyeŋ geb. Al kura amaŋ amaŋ irde uluŋde u irmeke keneŋbe al gobe gog po yeŋbe kuŋ tenayiŋ,” yinyiŋ.
Be, Yudas go bikkeŋ mere gwahade yinyiŋde geb, kuŋ forok yeŋ Yesu hitte kuŋbe, “Wawuŋ, Tisa,” ineŋbe uluŋde u iryiŋ.
Irkeb Yesu beleŋ wol heŋbe, “Kadne, gwaha tiye yeŋ wayha go gwaha tiya,” inyiŋ. Irkeb al wayamiŋ mar goreb waŋ teŋ fere tiyamiŋ.
Irkeb Yesu komatmiŋ kura yeŋ binde hinhin goreb fuleŋare niŋ bidilamiŋ marde pris buda gote kuruŋmiŋde meteŋ almiŋ kura kirmiŋ sapa iryiŋ.
Irkeb Yesu beleŋ, “Bidilage go gasuŋeŋde kera! Al kura bidila beleŋ al gasa yiryeŋ gob haniŋ wol hekeb gwaha mat po mayke kamyeŋ.
Adone gusuŋaŋ irmekeb goyare po miyoŋmiŋ budam wor po yad yerke kateŋ faraŋ nurnayiŋ gobe ma nurde ha?
Goyenbe mata gwahade tiyeŋbe Al Kuruŋyen asaŋde mata gwahade gwahade forok yiyyeŋ yitiŋ goyen daha mat forok yiyyeŋ? Epte moŋ,” inyiŋ.

Gwaha ineŋbe Yesu go yeŋ teŋ fere titek mar goyen, “Ne gayen kawe mar yad kuŋ hime geb, gago fuleŋare niŋ bidilaya nukwaya manaŋ waŋ nawarniŋ teŋ haŋ? Nebe naŋkahalmiŋ naŋkahalmiŋ Al Kuruŋyen ya bana saba tagalde himekeyabe ma nade haŋyen.
Goyenbe Al Kuruŋyen asaŋde mere basaŋ marmiŋ beleŋ kame mata gwahade forok yiyyeŋ yeŋ kayamiŋ goyen deŋ beleŋ gago teŋ haŋ,” yinyiŋ. Be, komatmiŋ yagobe tumŋaŋ Yesu tubul teŋ busaharamiŋ.
Yesu pris buda gote kuruŋmiŋ diliŋ mar huwaryiŋ
Be, Yesube pris buda gote kuruŋmiŋ Kaiafas hitte tukamiŋ. Gorbe Moseyen saba marya Yuda marte doyaŋ mar parguwak yagoya gabu iramiŋ.

Be, Pita go mel gore Yesu teŋ kuŋ hikeya gisaw yarham po heŋ gama irde kuriŋ. Kuŋ kuŋbe pris buda gote kuruŋmiŋ Kaiafasyen ya koya beleŋ po milgu irtiŋ bana goŋ al gabu irde haŋyen sawsaware hurkuriŋ. Hurkuŋbe daha kura tike keneŋ yeŋ ya go doyaŋ irde haŋyen mar keperde hinhande gor kuŋ kipiryiŋ.
Be, pris buda gote karkuwaŋmiŋya Yuda marte doyaŋ marya goyen tumŋaŋ gabu irde da misiŋde wor po Yesu go mayteke kamyeŋ yeŋ mere sege iramiŋ. Goyenbe miŋ kura ma keneŋbe goke naŋkenamiŋ.
Irkeb al budam waŋ Yesu tagal uneŋ uneŋ niŋ usi mere budam yad forok yiramiŋ. Gega Yesu maytek meremiŋ igiŋ kura ma kenamiŋ. Irkeb kuŋ kuŋ funaŋ al irawa kura waŋbe,
“Al gareb, ‘Al Kuruŋyen ya balem goyen upew urde sopte gergeŋ irde naŋa fay karwore pasi ireŋ,’ yeke nuraruŋ,” yaryum.
Be, pris buda gote kuruŋmiŋ Kaiafas beleŋ huwardeb Yesu goyen, “Mere kuruŋ ulger irhar gabe wol ma hawayiŋ?” inyiŋ.
Goyenbe Yesu go meremiŋ ma wol heŋ balmiŋ po hinhin. Irkeb sopte, “Ne beleŋ Al Kuruŋ gwahader hitiŋ gote saŋiŋde ginhem geb, gebe Mesaia Al Kuruŋ Urmiŋ ma dahade goyen momoŋ dira,” inyiŋ.

Gwaha inkeb Yesu beleŋ wol heŋbe, “Dindikeŋ gog po yahaŋ. Goyenbe ne beleŋbe deŋ kuruŋ gayen gaha dineŋ. Kame ne Al Urmiŋ gabe Al Kuruŋ saŋiŋ miŋyaŋ Al gote haniŋ yase beleŋ mat keperde naŋkiŋde gagap hende kateŋ himeke nennayiŋ,” yinyiŋ.

Irkeb pris buda gote kuruŋmiŋ gore mere goyen nurdeb, “Al gabe Al Kuruŋ sukal ira,” yeŋ biŋ ar yeke uliŋhormiŋ erek irdeb, “Niŋgeb daniŋ mere hoyaŋ niŋ naŋkentek? Al Kuruŋ sukal ira gobe deŋ tumŋaŋ nurhaŋ gago.
Niŋgeb deŋbe dahade nurde haŋ?” yineŋ gusuŋaŋ yiryiŋ. Irkeb wol heŋbe, “Kamyeŋ po!” inamiŋ.
Irdeb al gor hinhan goreb Yesu kimiŋde meyaŋ iramiŋ.
Irdeb kimiŋ mala teŋbe haniŋ mupi irde mayamiŋ. Kura beleŋbe palasi irdeb, “Mesaia, ganuŋ beleŋ muguna? Momoŋ dira!” inamiŋ.
Pita beleŋ Yesu niŋ helwaŋ hiriŋ
Be, goyarebe Pita go ya go biŋ bana sawsaware gor keperde hinhin. Irkeb meteŋ bere kura gore waŋbe, “Ge manaŋ Yesu Galili niŋ al goya kuŋ hinaryum,” inyiŋ.
Irkeb Pita beleŋbe al tumŋaŋ gor hinhan gote diliŋ mar helwaŋ heŋbe, “Neb goke kura yeŋ ha yeŋ ma nurde hime,” inyiŋ.
Irdeb gasuŋ hinhin go tubul teŋbe kuŋ yamere huwarde hikeb bere kura gore waŋ keneŋbe al buda gor hinhan goyen, “Al gabe Nasaret niŋ al Yesuya kuŋ haryen,” yiriŋ.
Irkeb Pita gore tebaŋ po helwaŋ heŋbe, “Fudinde wor po, nebe al gobe ma nurde uneŋ hime,” yiriŋ.
Be, hitŋeŋ muŋ kura teŋbe al gor hinhan goreb Pita goyen, “Mere tike melakge nurhet gobe Yesu gama irde haŋyen mar al kurabe ge gago yeŋ nurhet,” inamiŋ.
Irkeb Pita beleŋbe mere fudinde po tihim yeŋ biŋa teŋbe, “Fudinde wor po dineŋ hime. Neb al goke yeŋ haŋ yeŋ ma nurde hime,” yinyiŋ. Irkeb goyare po tatirok mere tiyyiŋ.

Irkeb Pita go Yesu beleŋ, “Tatirok ma mere tikeyabe ne niŋ yeŋ wawuŋ karwore, ‘Al gob ma nurde uneŋ hime,’ yawayiŋ,” inyiŋ goke biŋ bak yiriŋ. Irkeb siŋare kateŋ kuŋ mata tiyyiŋ goke biŋde misiŋ wor po nurdeb esiriŋ.

footnotes.text: Bikkeŋ Israel mar Isip naŋa tubul teŋ Kenan kuniŋ tiyamiŋyabe Al Kuruŋ beleŋ sipsip al diriŋ dirŋeŋ gasa yirde darim yade yame kantayaŋ sam yirnayiŋ yinyiŋ. Munaŋ al kura gwaha ma tiyamiŋ marbe Al Kuruŋyen miyoŋ beleŋ waŋbe mel gote urmiŋ mataliŋya dapŋamiŋ mataliŋya goyen tumŋaŋ gasa yirke kamamiŋ. Gega meremiŋ gama iramiŋ marbe miyoŋmiŋ beleŋ yubul tiyamiŋ goke dufay heŋ heŋ ge dula mata teŋ hinhan.
